description: Prediction - Ask the group what they think will happen with {topic}

actions.action_goal: {"id": "prediction_{topic_id}", "description": "Ask the group to make predictions about {topic} and compare their views.", "success_criteria": [{"id": "c1", "description": "{robot_name} asks the group: What do you think will happen with {topic}?", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c2", "description": "At least one participant shares their prediction.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c3", "description": "{robot_name} continues facilitating the discussion for {discussion_time}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}], "timeout": {"max_time": {"minutes": 5, "seconds": 0}, "max_turns": null}, "additional_instructions": ["Address the group as a whole.", "Compare different predictions."]}

topic.description: What to predict (e.g., 'the weather tomorrow', 'the next big trend', 'how the story ends')

discussion_time.description: How long to continue the discussion (e.g., '2 minutes', '90 seconds')
